events.event_name: AC/DC PWR/UP Pop Up — New York
events.address: Hard Rock Cafe Times Square, 1501 Broadway, New York, NY 10036
events.what_it_is: The official AC/DC PWR/UP Tour fan pop-up with exclusive merchandise, tour props and displays, photo opportunities, themed elements and on-site giveaways at Hard Rock Cafe Times Square.
events.what_is_free: Entry, fan displays/photo opportunities and eligibility for advertised on-site giveaways; merchandise, food and drinks may cost extra.
events.caveats: The official tour pop-up program confirms New York at Hard Rock Cafe on Sept. 24–25. A current NYC venue listing additionally advertises an open-to-all Fan Preview Night Sept. 23, 7–9 PM. No concert ticket is required. Merchandise and food/drink are not represented as free.
events.practical_notes: Fan Preview Night: Wed Sept. 23, 7–9 PM. Public event: Thu Sept. 24, 11 AM–9 PM; Fri Sept. 25, 11 AM–6 PM. Hard Rock Cafe Times Square, 1501 Broadway.

occurrences.details: Fan Preview Night; current venue listing says open to all and no concert ticket is required.
